research.arcananaturae.arcane_chest.stag: A warded door keeps a room shut. A chest that knew its owner would keep the room's contents safe as well.

Arcane Chests belong to whoever places them. Only players with access may open or break them; give access with Thaumaturge's arcane keys or with thaumium keys. Hoppers cannot reach into them and explosions do not touch them. The greatwood chest holds 54 stacks, the silverwood chest 77. Sneak-use a wand on your own chest to pack it up with everything inside.
research.arcananaturae.arcane_keys.stage: Iron and gold keys open one lock each. A key of thaumium could be made to carry a person's rights instead.

The Key of Unraveling is forged by whoever crafts it (or sneak-uses it first). Hit a player with it to bind it to them, then hand it over: the bound player can use it on any arcane lock the forger owns to gain access. The Key of Endorsing collects the players you hit with it; use it on a lock you own (or hold gold rights to) to give all of them access at once. Both work on arcane doors, pressure plates and arcane chests, and neither is used up.
research.arcananaturae.arcane_keys.title: Thaumium Keys
research.arcananaturae.carpentry.stage_0: Tired of the same magical wood in every wall, you took a chisel and a little gold to it: carved panels, gilded rosettes and trims of greatwood, pale panels and tiles of silverwood. With a Phenomorphous Stone in the crafting grid, plain greatwood and silverwood planks turn into these looks and back again, and the stone comes back out of the grid.
research.arcananaturae.carpentry.title: Woods
research.arcananaturae.colour_conversion: Crafted together with a Phenomorphous Stone, wool and terracotta take on the opposite colour: white turns black, orange turns red, yellow turns green. The stone comes back out of the grid.
research.arcananaturae.construction_focu: The Exchange focus swaps one block for another. Turned around, the same pattern could lay down new blocks where there were none.

Construction is a spell effect for your foci. Pick a block with your caster as you would for Exchange, then cast at a surface: Construction builds the picked block onto the face you hit, taking the blocks from your inventory. Its radius setting builds a single block (0), a 3x3 square (1) or a 5x5 square (2).
research.arcananaturae.dark_goggles.stag: Lenses ground from crystallised entropy drink the light. Looking through them is unsettling, but what hides in the dark cannot hide from them.

The Dark Crystal Goggles reveal like Goggles of Revealing and lower vis costs by 7%. Blindness and darkness fall away while you wear them, and invisible creatures show as faint ghosts. Repair them with gold.
research.arcananaturae.ender_pouch.stage: A pouch stitched with ender thread opens onto the same pocket of space as an ender chest.
Use the Enderic Focus Pouch to open your ender chest wherever you are. It can be worn in a Curios belt slot.
research.arcananaturae.ender_pouch.title: Enderic Focus Pouch
research.arcananaturae.evil_trunk.stage_: A chest that follows you would be useful. A chest that bites whatever follows you would be better. Given a brain and a little of the soul, a trunk could learn to do both.

Use a packed trunk on the ground to let it out. It is yours: it follows you, holds 36 stacks, bites what attacks you and what you attack, mends itself slowly and eats food you hand it to heal faster. Fire, lava, falls and water do not hurt it. Right-click it to open it; sneak-use it with an empty hand to pack it back into its item, contents and all. The Corrupted Trunk can be infused again into a Sinister, Demonic or Tainted one.
research.arcananaturae.evil_trunk.title: Evil Trunks
research.arcananaturae.geo_occultism.sta: Where vis pools long enough, the land itself takes on its colour. With enough essentia, you might choose the colour yourself.

Sneak-use the Biome Sampler on the ground to record the biome there; its tooltip shows the aspects of that biome. Use the sampler on a Geo Pylon to set the pylon's target. The pylon only works raised on its plinth: one empty block under it, then three Obsidian Tiles. Use it with an empty hand to start or stop it, and sneak-use it to see what it is doing. It turns the land within 8 blocks into the target biome one 4x4 patch at a time. Each patch costs 4 of each of the biome's aspects, drawn from jars and other essentia stores within 4 blocks of the pylon.
research.arcananaturae.intro.stage_0: Every thaumaturge bends vis to their will. Few look past the flux and the corruption to see the plain beauty of the living world it flows through. The naturalist does: by knowing the nature of things, one may shape plants, stone and creatures without breaking them. These notes collect what that way of thinking has taught you.
research.arcananaturae.intro.title: Inherent Law
research.arcananaturae.mutation_stone.st: Amber holds a moment still. Infused with change, it might instead let you choose which moment a block shows.

Click a block with the Phenomorphous Stone to change its look: wool, carpet, glass, terracotta and concrete through every colour, logs, planks, stairs and slabs through every wood, stone bricks, sandstone, quartz, cobblestone and dirt through their variants. Sneak-click to turn logs, pillars, stairs and slabs. The stone is never used up.
research.arcananaturae.prison_jar.stage_: A warded jar holds essentia without a drop escaping. Stretched with ender pearls, it might hold something that walks.
Use the Prison Jar on a creature to seal it inside, and use the full jar on a block to let it out again. The creature keeps its name, health and gear. Players and bosses cannot be caught.
research.arcananaturae.prison_jar.title: Prison Jar
research.arcananaturae.quicksilver_stone: Quicksilver will not hold a shape. Bound in amber, perhaps it can twist the shape of what already flows through a body.

Use the Quicksilver Stone to strengthen your active effects. Each effect costs one glowstone dust and rises one level, but keeps only a third of its remaining time. An effect already at level III overloads instead, leaving you sick and poisoned. Without an understanding of Permutatio the stone only makes you dizzy.
research.arcananaturae.research_log.stag: Breaking things down on the Deconstruction Table teaches you something every time, but only while you stand there to take it in. A log could keep those findings until you have time to read them.

Sneak-use the Research Log on a Deconstruction Table to file the aspect it broke out. The log keeps up to 64 of each aspect. Use the log to read it: everything it holds goes into your aspect pool and the log is empty again.
research.arcananaturae.revenant_focus.st: The dead do not rest easily where vis runs thick. A little coaxing could raise one to fight at your side, for a while.

Revenant is a spell effect for your foci. Cast it at a creature and a small zombie claws its way up beside you to attack it. Revenants never turn on you, do not burn in daylight, drop nothing and crumble after a minute. At most six stand at once. Players are only attacked when PvP is on.
research.arcananaturae.sickle_of_abundan: A field reaped by hand gives what it gives. Infused with greed, a sickle might ask for more, and bring the harvest home on its own.

The Sickle of Abundance reaps up to nine steps from the cut. Every crop it takes yields two extra harvests, and everything it reaps flies straight into your pack; what does not fit lands at your feet. Silk Touch turns the extra harvests off.
research.arcananaturae.sickles.stage_0: A hoe tills and a scythe mows, but a short curved blade in the right hands could reap a whole patch at once.
research.arcananaturae.sickles.stage_1: The Thaumium Sickle cuts plants, crops, leaves and webs quickly, and every touching plant of the same kind falls with the one you cut, up to two steps away. Ripe crops only take ripe neighbours with them. Sneak to cut a single plant. It also shears sheep and other shearable creatures.
research.arcananaturae.sickles.title: Sickles
research.arcananaturae.spectacles.stage_: Goggles of Revealing see a great deal, but they are heavy on the nose. A lighter frame of gold, with the lenses of two thaumometers, might see as much and a little more.
The Spectacles reveal like Goggles of Revealing and lower vis costs by 6%. They also name whatever block or creature sits under your crosshair. Repair them with gold.
research.arcananaturae.spectacles.title: Spectacles
research.arcananaturae.transcribing_tabl: A table that keeps the log for you would let a whole room of Deconstruction Tables work while you are away.

Put a Research Log in the Transcribing Table. Every two seconds it checks one Deconstruction Table two blocks away (straight or diagonal, on the same level) and files that table's result into the log. When the log cannot take any more of what it finds, the log moves to the output slot. Hoppers can feed logs in from the sides and bottom and take finished logs out.
research.arcananaturae.void_sickle.stage: Void metal hungers. A sickle of it might reap further still, and feed on what it cuts.
The Void Sickle reaps up to four steps from the cut, mends itself slowly while carried, and leaves what it strikes weakened. Like all void gear it weighs a little on the mind.
research.arcananaturae.void_sickle.title: Void Sickle
